about: The dialogue modes this card can press — an index that points at the detailed description of each. The vendor guides say what the model accepts; this file says what WE do with it, and where the full explanation lives.
law: The kit makes the dialogue beforehand (operator, 2026-11-11): a window carries OUR line or declares no dialogue — never a line the render invents. The mode is DERIVED from the payload (which of audio_clips rows and ref_audios the doc carries), never declared by an author.

authority.code: the card's compose walk (card.ts) — the film arm reads rows and references off the admitted doc
authority.detail: skills/prompt-writing/SKILL.md §5 — the mode table there is this file's rendering, never a second source
authority.gate: promptGate.ts — checkPress runs the dialogue rules (h3-prompt-dictionary.json) at compose and press
